scope_label: India, Azad Hind and princely-state awarding systems

sources.content_coverage: All eight public result pages and all 484 discovered object/version pages in the post-independence and pre-independence state trees
sources.coverage_result: 8/8 result pages and 484/484 object pages processed without failures; 269/269 exposed images cached. Sixty-nine pictured grade/type rows in 46 families and 113 unique local views were promoted across nine awarding polities; 415 pages remain in the unpictured appendix. One source-side duplicated/mismatched Siachen illustration was excluded.

sources.coverage_result: 31/31 linked award pages processed and 70/70 exposed non-site-chrome files cached. Seventeen differential grade/type rows in 13 represented families and 34 complete local views were promoted; ribbon-only files were excluded from the formal catalogue.

sources.source_name: MedalBook — British India core award-family trees
sources.content_coverage: Nine complete family pages: Star of India, Indian Empire, Crown of India, Order of British India, Indian Order of Merit, Indian Distinguished Service Medal, Indian Police Medal and Kaisar-i-Hind; inconsistent Indian Order of Merit route included explicitly
sources.coverage_result: 9/9 family entry pages and all 28 discovered object/branch pages processed without failures; 97/97 images cached. Twenty-two pictured grade/type rows in seven families and 39 unique local views were promoted; two non-award division branch pages were excluded and four award pages remain unpictured.
